title: The Commons shuts its door on Black Rod at State Opening
body: At the UK's State Opening of Parliament, the official called Black Rod approaches to summon MPs to hear the monarch's speech. The Commons door is shut, and Black Rod knocks three times before entering.
takeaway: The ceremony makes the Commons' independence visible even while the chambers gather for a shared event.
source: UK Parliament, State Opening: The Public Sequence of Events
visual: a ceremonial rod held before a tall closed door in Parliament

title: Canada created a chief election officer in 1920
body: Canada's Dominion Elections Act of 1920 created the position of Chief Electoral Officer. The office oversees federal elections, a recurring function that continues between votes.
takeaway: Election administration includes registration and preparation long before the day people cast ballots.
source: Elections Canada, Chief Electoral Officer of Canada
